comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body:
Where have you been for the past 1 year? It's been like this ever since EA arrived:
1. Pirates will be pirates and steall items from you that's why they are called pirates in the first place.
2. Honest traders are still around and I salute each and one of them.
3. Scammers/Resellers are part of the game. Not just in UWO but all online games even in real life nothin you can do about it.

Good thing is they nerfed EA goods from 2nd age so dungeoning in not that profitable anymore and you will notice people are tyring to be more cautious now in spending ducats as all you can see is WTS, WTS, WTS not WTB. It's a first step to control the prices so hopefully it will continue in time.
